sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Camulos is a British god. Little evidence of his worship survives. His name appears in the Roman town name Camulodunum. That name means “fort of Camulos.” The town became the city of Colchester. The invading Romans linked Camulos to their war god Mars. Some scholars treat Camulos as a mirror of the Irish ancestor Cumhall. Cumhall sired the hero Fionn Mac Cumhaill.
